Title: Implement splitbrain_route_task tool (dry-run routing decision)
Description: Runs the routing scoring algorithm WITHOUT executing inference. Given a TaskType and optional requirements, returns the full routing decision: winning node+model, all candidate scores, policy applied, decision time. Critical for debugging ('why did my task go to Node B?') and for clients that want to pre-validate node availability before dispatching long tasks. Parameters: taskType, requiredCapabilities?, minContextWindow?, routingPolicy?. Returns: winnerNodeId, winnerModel, allCandidateScores, policyApplied, decisionMs.
